title: Work surface naming
scope: Rename the user-facing Tasks surface to Work and describe its contents as Requests & ideas without changing Demand persistence or routing.
acceptance: Focus, Workspaces, and Work are the only primary surface labels.
Requests & ideas is the visible contextual subtitle for the Work surface.
Goal remains the outcome concept for an individual item; Demand remains the persisted protocol identity.
The mainSurface board route, selection, recovery, and Demand APIs remain unchanged.
